--- FILE: src/app/(frontend)/actions.ts ---
export type FeedbackResult = {
  ok: boolean
  message: string
  fieldErrors?: Partial<Record<'category' | 'message' | 'contact', string>>
}

export async function submitFeedback(input: {
  category: string
  message: string
  contact: string
}): Promise<FeedbackResult> {
  const category = String(input.category || '').trim()
  const message = String(input.message || '').trim()
  const contact = String(input.contact || '').trim()
  const fieldErrors: FeedbackResult['fieldErrors'] = {}

  if (!['suggestion', 'bug', 'content'].includes(category)) {
    fieldErrors.category = 'Vui lòng chọn loại phản hồi.'
  }
  if (message.length < 10 || message.length > 2000) {
    fieldErrors.message = 'Nội dung cần từ 10 đến 2.000 ký tự.'
  }
  if (contact.length > 160) {
    fieldErrors.contact = 'Thông tin liên hệ tối đa 160 ký tự.'
  }
  if (Object.keys(fieldErrors).length) {
    return { ok: false, message: 'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại thông tin.', fieldErrors }
  }

  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      await fetch('/api/sanctuary/event', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ type: 'FEEDBACK', category, message, contact, time: Date.now() })
      });
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: 'Cảm ơn bạn. Phản hồi đã được gửi tới Chùa An Nhiên.',
    }
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: 'Cảm ơn bạn. Phản hồi đã được ghi nhận.',
    }
  }
}


--- FILE: src/app/(frontend)/app-font.ts ---
/** CSS variable published by next/font in layout.tsx. */
export const APP_FONT_VARIABLE = '--font-be-vietnam-pro'

/** Resolve the app font (Be Vietnam Pro via next/font) for canvas text. */
export function appFontFamily() {
  const family = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
    .getPropertyValue(APP_FONT_VARIABLE)
    .trim()
  return family || '"Be Vietnam Pro", system-ui, sans-serif'
}

/**
 * Wait until the primary face is ready for canvas drawing. Only the first
 * family is requested: next/font's metric fallback face may not exist locally.
 * Never rejects, so callers can always redraw afterwards.
 */
export function whenAppFontReady(weights: string[]) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.fonts) return Promise.resolve()
  const primary = appFontFamily().split(',')[0].trim()
  return Promise.all(weights.map((weight) => document.fonts.load(`${weight} 32px ${primary}`)))
    .then(() => undefined)
    .catch(() => undefined)
}


--- FILE: src/app/(frontend)/audio.ts ---
/**
 * Chùa An Nhiên — High-Fidelity Audio Engine
 * Tích hợp toàn diện 3 file âm thanh gốc trong thư mục "nhac/":
 * 1. nhac/tieng_go_mo.mp3       -> Tiếng gõ mõ thanh tịnh (Web Audio Buffer + Rapid HTML5 Audio Pool)
 * 2. nhac/tieng_chuong_chua.mp3 -> Tiếng chuông Đại Hồng Chung ngân vang sâu lắng
 * 3. nhac/nhac_thien_nen.mp3   -> Nhạc thiền nền tịnh tâm, tự động bật khi vào trang, tự động dừng khi thoát/ẩn Chrome trên mobile
 *
 * Tự động có âm tổng hợp (synthesizer) làm phương án dự phòng (fallback) nếu mạng hoặc thiết bị gặp sự cố.
 */

function resolveAssetUrl(relPath: string): string {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return relPath
  try {
    const base = document.baseURI || window.location.href
    return new URL(relPath, base).href
  } catch (_) {
    return relPath
  }
}

const AUDIO_FILES = {
  get woodblock() {
    return resolveAssetUrl('nhac/tieng_go_mo.mp3')
  },
  get templeBell() {
    return resolveAssetUrl('nhac/tieng_chuong_chua.mp3')
  },
  get ambient() {
    return resolveAssetUrl('nhac/nhac_thien_nen.mp3')
  },
}

let context: AudioContext | null = null
let masterGain: GainNode | null = null

// Pre-decoded Web Audio buffers for instant 0ms latency playback
let woodblockBuffer: AudioBuffer | null = null
let bellBuffer: AudioBuffer | null = null
let audioPreloadStarted = false

// HTML5 Audio fallback pool for rapid wooden fish knocks
let moAudioPool: HTMLAudioElement[] = []
let moPoolIndex = 0
let bellAudioFallback: HTMLAudioElement | null = null

// Background ambient meditation music stream
let ambientAudio: HTMLAudioElement | null = null
let ambientTargetVolume = 0.3
let ambientDesiredState = true // Auto-start background meditation music by default
let gestureUnlockAttached = false
let lifecycleListenersAttached = false

function getAudioContext(): { ctx: AudioContext; out: GainNode } | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null
  if (!context) {
    const AudioContextClass =
      window.AudioContext ??
      (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext
    if (!AudioContextClass) return null
    context = new AudioContextClass()
    masterGain = context.createGain()
    masterGain.gain.value = 0.95
    masterGain.connect(context.destination)
  }
  if (context.state === 'suspended' && !document.hidden) {
    void context.resume().catch(() => {})
  }
  return { ctx: context, out: masterGain! }
}

/**
 * Preload and decode audio buffers early so sounds play with 0ms delay.
 */
function preloadAssets() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || audioPreloadStarted) return
  audioPreloadStarted = true

  // 1. Initialize HTML5 Audio elements
  try {
    moAudioPool = Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => {
      const a = new Audio(AUDIO_FILES.woodblock)
      a.preload = 'auto'
      return a
    })
    bellAudioFallback = new Audio(AUDIO_FILES.templeBell)
    bellAudioFallback.preload = 'auto'
  } catch (_) {}

  // 2. Pre-fetch and decode Web Audio Buffers
  const setupBuffers = () => {
    const engine = getAudioContext()
    if (!engine || !window.fetch) return

    fetch(AUDIO_FILES.woodblock)
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.arrayBuffer() : Promise.reject('woodblock 404')))
      .then((buf) => engine.ctx.decodeAudioData(buf))
      .then((decoded) => {
        woodblockBuffer = decoded
      })
      .catch(() => {})

    fetch(AUDIO_FILES.templeBell)
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.arrayBuffer() : Promise.reject('bell 404')))
      .then((buf) => engine.ctx.decodeAudioData(buf))
      .then((decoded) => {
        bellBuffer = decoded
      })
      .catch(() => {})
  }

  setupBuffers()
  attachGestureUnlock()
  attachLifecycleListeners()

  // Attempt auto-start ambient music on initial page entry
  if (ambientDesiredState) {
    startAmbientPlayback()
  }
}

/**
 * Auto-unlock AudioContext and Ambient Music on first user interaction.
 */
function attachGestureUnlock() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || gestureUnlockAttached) return
  gestureUnlockAttached = true

  const unlock = () => {
    if (context && context.state === 'suspended' && !document.hidden) {
      void context.resume().catch(() => {})
    }
    // If user requested ambient music or auto-start is pending, play it on first interaction
    if (ambientDesiredState && ambientAudio && ambientAudio.paused && !document.hidden) {
      ambientAudio.play().catch(() => {})
    }
  }

  ;['pointerdown', 'touchstart', 'keydown', 'click'].forEach((event) => {
    window.addEventListener(event, unlock, { once: true, passive: true })
  })
}

/**
 * Handle mobile backgrounding / Chrome tab switching / app exit.
 * Yêu cầu: "nếu người dùng sử dụng mobile để truy cập vào thì khi người dùng chuyển
 * hoặc thoát khỏi ứng dụng chrome trên mobile thì nhạc nền dừng. Không chạy ngầm trong ứng dụng."
 */
function attachLifecycleListeners() {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined' || lifecycleListenersAttached) return
  lifecycleListenersAttached = true

  const handlePause = () => {
    if (ambientAudio && !ambientAudio.paused) {
      ambientAudio.pause()
    }
    if (context && context.state === 'running') {
      void context.suspend().catch(() => {})
    }
  }

  const handleResume = () => {
    if (ambientDesiredState && ambientAudio && ambientAudio.paused) {
      ambientAudio.play().catch(() => {})
    }
    if (context && context.state === 'suspended') {
      void context.resume().catch(() => {})
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden) {
      handlePause()
    } else {
      handleResume()
    }
  })

  window.addEventListener('pagehide', handlePause)
  window.addEventListener('freeze', handlePause)
}

function startAmbientPlayback() {
  if (!ambientAudio) {
    try {
      ambientAudio = new Audio(AUDIO_FILES.ambient)
      ambientAudio.loop = true
      ambientAudio.preload = 'metadata'
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  if (!ambientAudio) return

  ambientAudio.volume = ambientTargetVolume
  if (!document.hidden) {
    const playPromise = ambientAudio.play()
    if (playPromise) {
      playPromise.catch((_err) => {
        // Browser blocked unprompted autoplay; attach gesture unlock
        attachGestureUnlock()
      })
    }
  }
}

// Auto-preload on file load in browser
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', preloadAssets, { once: true })
  } else {
    preloadAssets()
  }
}

/**
 * Fallback tone synthesis if audio files cannot be loaded.
 */
function synthTone(
  ctx: AudioContext,
  out: AudioNode,
  frequency: number,
  peak: number,
  decay: number,
  type: OscillatorType = 'sine',
  start = ctx.currentTime,
) {
  const oscillator = ctx.createOscillator()
  const gain = ctx.createGain()
  oscillator.type = type
  oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, start)
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start)
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(peak, start + 0.006)
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + decay)
  oscillator.connect(gain).connect(out)
  oscillator.start(start)
  oscillator.stop(start + decay + 0.05)
  return oscillator
}

/**
 * Tiếng gõ mõ (Wooden Fish strike):
 * Ưu tiên 1: Web Audio Buffer từ nhac/tieng_go_mo.mp3 (chuẩn 0ms, không cắt tiếng cũ)
 * Ưu tiên 2: HTML5 Audio Pool từ nhac/tieng_go_mo.mp3 (gõ siêu tốc 10 lần/giây)
 * Dự phòng 3: Âm tổng hợp vật lý nếu file bị mất hoặc lỗi mạng
 */
export function playWoodblock() {
  preloadAssets()
  const engine = getAudioContext()

  // 1. Web Audio Buffer Source (Chất lượng cao nhất & không độ trễ)
  if (engine && woodblockBuffer) {
    try {
      const source = engine.ctx.createBufferSource()
      source.buffer = woodblockBuffer
      const gain = engine.ctx.createGain()
      gain.gain.value = 0.95
      source.connect(gain).connect(engine.out)
      source.start(0)
      return
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // 2. HTML5 Audio Pool (Hỗ trợ nhấp chuột liên tục)
  if (moAudioPool.length > 0) {
    try {
      const audio = moAudioPool[moPoolIndex]
      moPoolIndex = (moPoolIndex + 1) % moAudioPool.length
      audio.currentTime = 0
      audio.volume = 0.9
      const playPromise = audio.play()
      if (playPromise) {
        playPromise.catch(() => {})
      }
      return
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // 3. Fallback Synthesizer
  if (engine) {
    const { ctx, out } = engine
    const now = ctx.currentTime
    const body = synthTone(ctx, out, 760, 0.55, 0.22, 'triangle', now)
    body.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(430, now + 0.09)
    synthTone(ctx, out, 1520, 0.12, 0.06, 'sine', now)
  }
}

/**
 * Tiếng Chuông Chùa / Đại Hồng Chung:
 * Ưu tiên 1: Web Audio Buffer từ nhac/tieng_chuong_chua.mp3 (ngân vang 12-15s chân thực)
 * Ưu tiên 2: HTML5 Audio từ nhac/tieng_chuong_chua.mp3
 * Dự phòng 3: Bộ tổng hợp sóng đa hài chuông đồng
 */
export function playTempleBell() {
  preloadAssets()
  const engine = getAudioContext()

  // 1. Web Audio Buffer
  if (engine && bellBuffer) {
    try {
      const source = engine.ctx.createBufferSource()
      source.buffer = bellBuffer
      const gain = engine.ctx.createGain()
      gain.gain.value = 1.0
      source.connect(gain).connect(engine.out)
      source.start(0)
      return
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // 2. HTML5 Audio
  if (bellAudioFallback) {
    try {
      bellAudioFallback.currentTime = 0
      bellAudioFallback.volume = 0.95
      const p = bellAudioFallback.play()
      if (p) p.catch(() => {})
      return
    } catch (_) {}
  } else {
    try {
      const a = new Audio(AUDIO_FILES.templeBell)
      a.volume = 0.95
      a.play().catch(() => {})
      return
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // 3. Fallback Metallic Synthesis
  if (engine) {
    const { ctx, out } = engine
    const now = ctx.currentTime
    const base = 98
    const partials: [number, number, number][] = [
      [0.5, 0.32, 14],
      [1, 0.5, 12],
      [1.006, 0.3, 11],
      [2, 0.26, 8],
      [2.4, 0.18, 6],
      [3, 0.14, 5],
    ]
    partials.forEach(([ratio, peak, decay]) =>
      synthTone(ctx, out, base * ratio, peak, decay, 'sine', now),
    )
  }
}

/**
 * Tiếng khánh / chuông nhỏ báo công đức.
 */
export function playChime() {
  preloadAssets()
  const engine = getAudioContext()
  if (!engine) return
  const { ctx, out } = engine
  const now = ctx.currentTime
  synthTone(ctx, out, 880, 0.09, 1.6, 'sine', now)
  synthTone(ctx, out, 1320, 0.05, 1.2, 'sine', now + 0.04)
}

/**
 * Nhạc thiền nền tĩnh tâm (nhac/nhac_thien_nen.mp3):
 * - Tự động lặp vô tận (loop = true)
 * - Tự động bật khi vào trang
 * - Tự động tạm dừng khi chuyển tab hoặc ẩn trình duyệt Chrome mobile
 * - Mở khóa Autoplay thông minh khi người dùng chạm vào màn hình
 * - Tăng/giảm âm lượng êm dịu, không giật
 */
export function setAmbient(on: boolean, volume = 0.3) {
  preloadAssets()
  ambientDesiredState = on
  ambientTargetVolume = volume

  if (!ambientAudio) {
    try {
      ambientAudio = new Audio(AUDIO_FILES.ambient)
      ambientAudio.loop = true
      ambientAudio.preload = 'metadata'
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  if (!ambientAudio) return

  if (!on) {
    // Fade out smoothly
    const curVol = ambientAudio.volume
    let step = 0
    const fadeTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
      step++
      if (ambientAudio && ambientAudio.volume > 0.05) {
        ambientAudio.volume = Math.max(0, curVol * (1 - step / 10))
      } else {
        window.clearInterval(fadeTimer)
        if (ambientAudio) {
          ambientAudio.pause()
          ambientAudio.currentTime = 0
        }
      }
    }, 50)
    return
  }

  // Turn ON: Resume AudioContext and play ambient track
  if (context && context.state === 'suspended' && !document.hidden) {
    void context.resume().catch(() => {})
  }

  ambientAudio.volume = volume
  if (!document.hidden) {
    const playPromise = ambientAudio.play()
    if (playPromise) {
      playPromise.catch((_err) => {
        // Browser blocked autoplay without user gesture yet; wait for gesture unlock
        attachGestureUnlock()
      })
    }
  }
}

      strokeLinejoin="round"
    >
      {paths[name]}
    </svg>
  )
}

const tasks = [
  { id: 'beads', icon: 'circle' as IconName, title: 'Lần 27 hạt', target: 27, action: 'Mở' },
  {
    id: 'incense',
    icon: 'incense' as IconName,
    title: 'Dâng một nén hương',
    target: 1,
    action: 'Đi',
  },
  { id: 'buddha', icon: 'hand' as IconName, title: 'Lạy Phật một lạy', target: 1, action: 'Lạy' },
]

type ActionId =
  | 'quests'
  | 'knock'
  | 'bow'
  | 'incense'
  | 'chant'
  | 'bell'
  | 'fortune'
  | 'lantern'
  | 'release'
  | 'breath'
  | 'teaching'
  | 'petition'
  | 'certificate'
  | 'video'
  | 'more'

// Core rituals first so thumbs reach them without scrolling on phones.
const actions: { id: ActionId; icon: IconName; label: string; hint?: string }[] = [
  { id: 'quests', icon: 'list', label: 'Việc lành' },
  { id: 'knock', icon: 'fish', label: 'Gõ mõ', hint: 'Space' },
  { id: 'bow', icon: 'hand', label: 'Lễ Phật' },
  { id: 'incense', icon: 'incense', label: 'Dâng hương' },
  { id: 'chant', icon: 'book', label: 'Kinh thư', hint: 'K' },
  { id: 'bell', icon: 'bell', label: 'Chuông' },
  { id: 'fortune', icon: 'stick', label: 'Xin xăm' },
  { id: 'lantern', icon: 'lantern', label: 'Hoa đăng' },
  { id: 'release', icon: 'bird', label: 'Phóng sanh' },
  { id: 'breath', icon: 'wind', label: 'Thiền thở' },
  { id: 'teaching', icon: 'quote', label: 'Pháp cú' },
  { id: 'petition', icon: 'scroll', label: 'Dâng sớ' },
  { id: 'certificate', icon: 'seal', label: 'Công đức' },
  { id: 'video', icon: 'video', label: 'Gọi Video' },
  { id: 'more', icon: 'more', label: 'Thêm' },
]

type Props = {
  practices: PracticeItem[]
  calendar: CalendarItem[]
}

type SavedProgress = {
  playerName: string
  dharmaName: string
  merit: number
  beads: number
  knocks: number
  done: Record<string, number>
  wishes: string[]
  petitions: Petition[]
  room: number
  theme: string
  muted: boolean
}

const isTyping = (target: EventTarget | null) =>
  target instanceof HTMLElement &&
  Boolean(target.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable]'))

export default function ChuaSenApp({ practices, calendar }: Props) {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(true)
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false)
  const [meditating, setMeditating] = useState(false)
  const [ambientOn, setAmbientOn] = useState(true)
  const [activeAction, setActiveAction] = useState<ActionId>('knock')
  const [done, setDone] = useState<Record<string, number>>({})
  const [toast, setToast] = useState('')
  const [panel, setPanel] = useState<PanelId | null>(null)
  const [communityOpen, setCommunityOpen] = useState(false)
  const [callOpen, setCallOpen] = useState(false)
  const [playerName, setPlayerName] = useState('Tuệ Phúc')
  const [dharmaName, setDharmaName] = useState('')
  const [merit, setMerit] = useState(0)
  const [beads, setBeads] = useState(0)
  const [knocks, setKnocks] = useState(0)
  const [knockPulse, setKnockPulse] = useState(0)
  const [autoKnock, setAutoKnock] = useState(false)
  const [wishes, setWishes] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [petitions, setPetitions] = useState<Petition[]>([])
  const [room, setRoom] = useState(4)
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('xanh')
  const [phrase, setPhrase] = useState('')
  const [seat, setSeat] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [onlineCount, setOnlineCount] = useState(1)
  const seatRef = useRef(seat)
  seatRef.current = seat
  const [hydrated, setHydrated] = useState(false)
  const sceneRef = useRef<SceneApi | null>(null)
  const moveScene = useCallback((x: number, y: number) => sceneRef.current?.setMove(x, y), [])
  const mutedRef = useRef(muted)
  mutedRef.current = muted
  const doneRef = useRef(done)
  doneRef.current = done
  const knocksRef = useRef(knocks)
  knocksRef.current = knocks

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateCount = (e?: any) => {
      const list = e?.detail || ((window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.activeDevotees
        ? Array.from((window as any).SupabaseSanctuary.activeDevotees.values())
        : [])
      setOnlineCount(1 + list.length)
    }
    window.addEventListener('sanctuary_devotees_updated', updateCount)
    updateCount()
    const timer = setInterval(updateCount, 2000)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('sanctuary_devotees_updated', updateCount)
      clearInterval(timer)
    }
  }, [])
  useEffect(() => {
    const prof = (window as any).currentUserProfile
    if (prof) {
      if (prof.fullName) setPlayerName(prof.fullName)
      if (prof.dharmaName) setDharmaName(prof.dharmaName)
      if (typeof prof.assignedSeatNo === 'number') {
        setSeat(prof.assignedSeatNo)
      }
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const prof = (window as any).currentUserProfile
    if (prof) {
      prof.fullName = playerName
      prof.dharmaName = dharmaName
      ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.trackCurrentUserPresence?.()
    }
  }, [playerName, dharmaName])

  const completed = useMemo(() => Object.values(done).filter(Boolean).length, [done])
  const rank = levelFor(merit)
  const level = rank.level

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!toast) return
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setToast(''), 2600)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [toast])

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem('chua-sen-progress')
      if (raw) {
        const saved = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<SavedProgress>
        if (saved.playerName) setPlayerName(saved.playerName)
        if (typeof saved.dharmaName === 'string') setDharmaName(saved.dharmaName)
        if (typeof saved.merit === 'number') setMerit(saved.merit)
        if (typeof saved.beads === 'number') setBeads(saved.beads)
        if (typeof saved.knocks === 'number') setKnocks(saved.knocks)
        if (saved.done) setDone(saved.done)
        if (Array.isArray(saved.wishes)) setWishes(saved.wishes)
        if (Array.isArray(saved.petitions)) setPetitions(saved.petitions.slice(-20))
        if (typeof saved.room === 'number') setRoom(saved.room)
        if (saved.theme) {
          const t = saved.theme;
          setTheme(t);
          const col = ROBE_COLORS[t] || ROBE_COLORS.xanh;
          if ((window as any).currentUserProfile) {
            ;(window as any).currentUserProfile.robeTheme = t;
            ;(window as any).currentUserProfile.robeColor = col;
          }
          ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.broadcast?.('CHANGE_ROBE', {
            theme: t,
            robeColor: col,
          });
          ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.trackCurrentUserPresence?.();
        }
        if (typeof saved.muted === 'boolean') setMuted(saved.muted)
      }
    } catch {
      // Keep safe defaults if browser storage is unavailable or malformed.
    }
    setHydrated(true)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hydrated) return
    const data: SavedProgress = {
      playerName,
      dharmaName,
      merit,
      beads,
      knocks,
      done,
      wishes,
      petitions,
      room,
      theme,
      muted,
    }
    window.localStorage.setItem('chua-sen-progress', JSON.stringify(data))
  }, [
    beads,
    dharmaName,
    done,
    hydrated,
    knocks,
    merit,
    muted,
    petitions,
    playerName,
    room,
    theme,
    wishes,
  ])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (muted && ambientOn) {
      setAmbient(false)
      setAmbientOn(false)
    }
  }, [muted, ambientOn])
  useEffect(() => {
    // Tự động bật nhạc thiền nền khi vào trang
    setAmbient(true, 0.3)
    return () => setAmbient(false)
  }, [])

  const addMerit = useCallback((amount: number, message: string) => {
    if (amount) setMerit((current) => current + amount)
    setToast(message)
    if (!mutedRef.current && amount) playChime()
  }, [])

  const knock = useCallback(() => {
    if (!mutedRef.current) playWoodblock()
    setKnockPulse((value) => value + 1)
    const next = knocksRef.current + 1
    knocksRef.current = next
    setKnocks(next)
    if (next % 108 === 0) {
      setMerit((current) => current + 10)
      setToast(`Đã gõ ${next} tiếng mõ · +10 công đức`)
    }
    ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.broadcast?.('WOODEN_FISH', {
      seatNo: seatRef.current,
      phrase: 'Nam Mô A Di Đà Phật',
    })
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoKnock) return
    const timer = window.setInterval(knock, 1100)
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer)
  }, [autoKnock, knock])

  const completeTask = useCallback(
    (id: string, target: number, title: string) => {
      if (doneRef.current[id]) return
      doneRef.current = { ...doneRef.current, [id]: target }
      setDone(doneRef.current)
      addMerit(30, `Đã hoàn thành “${title}” · +30 công đức`)
    },
    [addMerit],
  )

  const offerIncense = useCallback(() => {
    const scene = sceneRef.current
    const award = () => {
      addMerit(20, 'Đã dâng 3 nén tâm hương lên Tam Bảo · +20 công đức')
      completeTask('incense', 1, 'Dâng một nén hương')
    }
    ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.broadcast?.('OFFER_INCENSE', {
      seatNo: seatRef.current,
    })
    if (scene) {
      setToast('Đang đi lên bàn thờ dâng hương…')
      scene.offerIncense(award)
    } else award()
  }, [addMerit, completeTask])

  const bow = useCallback(() => {
    sceneRef.current?.bow()
    if (!mutedRef.current) playTempleBell()
    ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.broadcast?.('BOW_BUDDHA', {
      seatNo: seatRef.current,
    })
    addMerit(5, 'Thành kính đảnh lễ Tam Bảo · +5 công đức')
    completeTask('buddha', 1, 'Lạy Phật một lạy')
  }, [addMerit, completeTask])

  const ringBell = useCallback(() => {
    sceneRef.current?.ringBell()
    if (!mutedRef.current) playTempleBell()
    ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.broadcast?.('TEMPLE_BELL', {
      seatNo: seatRef.current,
    })
    addMerit(5, 'Tiếng chuông ngân xa, thân tâm an trú · +5 công đức')
  }, [addMerit])

  const toggleSeat = useCallback(() => {
    if (seat !== null) sceneRef.current?.stand()
    else setPanel('seats')
  }, [seat])

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (isTyping(event.target) || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.altKey) return
      if (event.code === 'Space') {
        event.preventDefault()
        if (event.repeat) return
        if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.tagName === 'BUTTON')
          event.target.blur()
        knock()
        return
      }
      if (panel) return
      const key = event.key.toLowerCase()
      if (key === 'f') toggleSeat()
      else if (key === 'k') setPanel('chant')
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [knock, panel, toggleSeat])

  const toggleFullscreen = () => {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) void document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.()
    else void document.exitFullscreen?.()
  }

  const toggleAmbient = () => {
    const next = !ambientOn
    if (next && muted) setMuted(false)
    setAmbient(next, 0.3)
    setAmbientOn(next)
  }

  const chooseAction = (id: ActionId) => {
    setActiveAction(id)
    if (id === 'quests') setCollapsed((value) => !value)
    else if (id === 'knock') knock()
    else if (id === 'bow') bow()
    else if (id === 'incense') offerIncense()
    else if (id === 'bell') ringBell()
    else if (id === 'video') {
      setPanel(null)
      setCommunityOpen(false)
      if (typeof (window as any).startZaloVideoCall === 'function') {
        ;(window as any).startZaloVideoCall()
      } else {
        setCallOpen(true)
      }
    } else setPanel(id)
  }

  const runTask = (id: string, target: number, title: string) => {
    if (id === 'beads') setPanel('beads')
    else if (id === 'incense') offerIncense()
    else if (id === 'buddha') bow()
    else completeTask(id, target, title)
  }

  const updateBeads = (count: number) => {
    setBeads(count)
    if (count >= 27 && !done.beads) completeTask('beads', 27, 'Lần 27 hạt')
  }

  const practiceContext: PracticeContext = {
    playerName,
    dharmaName,
    merit,
    knocks,
    beads,
    seat,
    petitions,
    onSeat: (no) => {
      sceneRef.current?.sit(no)
      setToast(`Đang đi tới bồ đoàn #${no}…`)
    },
    onStand: () => sceneRef.current?.stand(),
    onName: setPlayerName,
    onDharma: setDharmaName,
    onPetition: (petition) => {
      setPetitions((current) => [...current, petition].slice(-20))
      addMerit(25, `Đã dâng ${petition.kind === 'an' ? 'sớ cầu an' : 'sớ cầu siêu'} · +25 công đức`)
    },
    onMerit: addMerit,
    onWish: (wish) => setWishes((current) => [...current, wish].slice(-20)),
    onNavigate: setPanel,
    onClose: () => setPanel(null),
  }

  return (
    <main className={`game-shell theme-${theme}`}>
      <TempleScene
        theme={theme}
        playerName={playerName}
        level={level}
        apiRef={sceneRef}
        onSeatChange={(next) => {
          setSeat(next)
          if ((window as any).currentUserProfile) {
            ;(window as any).currentUserProfile.assignedSeatNo = next
          }
          if (next !== null) {
            setToast(`Đã an tọa bồ đoàn #${next}. Nam mô A Di Đà Phật`)
            ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.broadcast?.('SANCTUARY_SIT_DOWN', { seatNo: next })
          } else {
            ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.broadcast?.('SANCTUARY_STAND_UP', {})
          }
          ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.trackCurrentUserPresence?.()
        }}
      />
      <div className="atmosphere" aria-hidden="true" />

      <header className="topbar">
        <button className="brand glass" onClick={() => setPanel('rooms')}>
          <span className="lotus-mark">
            <Icon name="lotus" size={17} />
          </span>
          <strong>Chùa An Nhiên</strong>
          <span className="online-dot" />
          <span className="room-name">Phòng {room}</span>
          <Icon name="chevron" size={14} />
        </button>

        <div className="top-actions">
          <div className="status-pill glass">
            <button
              className="visitor-count"
              type="button"
              aria-label="Xem người trong chùa"
              onClick={() => setPanel('people')}
            >
              <Icon name="users" size={16} /> {onlineCount}
            </button>
            <span className="divider" />
            <button type="button" aria-label="Hồ sơ tu tập" onClick={() => setPanel('profile')}>
              <Icon name="scroll" size={16} />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Mở Đạo Tràng Chung"
              onClick={() => {
                setPanel(null)
                setCommunityOpen(true)
              }}
            >
              <Icon name="message" size={16} />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={muted ? 'Bật âm thanh' : 'Tắt âm thanh'}
              onClick={() => setMuted(!muted)}
            >
              <Icon name={muted ? 'mute' : 'volume'} size={16} />
            </button>
            <button type="button" aria-label="Toàn màn hình" onClick={toggleFullscreen}>
              <Icon name="expand" size={15} />
            </button>
            <button type="button" aria-label="Cài đặt" onClick={() => setPanel('settings')}>
              <Icon name="settings" size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="quick-links">
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`mini-pill glass ${ambientOn ? 'active' : ''}`}
              aria-pressed={ambientOn}
              onClick={toggleAmbient}
            >
              <Icon name="music" size={15} /> {ambientOn ? 'Nhạc thiền 30%' : 'Nhạc thiền'}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`mini-pill glass ${meditating ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => {
                setMeditating(!meditating)
                setPanel('chant')
              }}
            >
              <Icon name="wave" size={15} /> {meditating ? 'Đang niệm Phật' : 'Nghe niệm Phật'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <aside className={`quest-panel glass ${collapsed ? 'collapsed' : ''}`}>
        <div className="quest-heading">
          <button
            type="button"
            className={`player-portrait portrait-${theme}`}
            aria-label="Mở hồ sơ tu tập"
            onClick={() => setPanel('profile')}
          >
            <i />
            <b />
          </button>
          <div>
            <h1>{playerName}</h1>
            <p>
              Cấp {level} · {rank.name} · {merit.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} công đức
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="collapse-button"
            aria-label={collapsed ? 'Mở việc lành hôm nay' : 'Thu gọn việc lành'}
            onClick={() => setCollapsed(!collapsed)}
          >
            <Icon name="chevron" size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {!collapsed && (
          <div className="quest-content">
            <div className="daily-row">
              <strong>
                Việc lành hôm nay <b>{completed}/3</b>
              </strong>
              <span>{completed * 30}/90</span>
            </div>
            <div className="progress">
              <i style={{ width: `${(completed / 3) * 100}%` }} />
            </div>
            <div className="task-list">
              {tasks.map((task) => {
                const isDone = Boolean(done[task.id])
                return (
                  <article className={`task ${isDone ? 'done' : ''}`} key={task.id}>
                    <span className="task-icon">
                      <Icon name={isDone ? 'check' : task.icon} size={18} />
                    </span>
                    <div className="task-copy">
                      <strong>{task.title}</strong>
                      <small>
                        {isDone ? task.target : 0}/{task.target} <b>· +30</b>
                      </small>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isDone}
                      onClick={() => runTask(task.id, task.target, task.title)}
                    >
                      {isDone ? 'Xong' : task.action}
                    </button>
                  </article>
                )
              })}
            </div>
            <p className="reward">
              <Icon name="sparkles" size={14} /> Xong cả 3 · <b>90 công đức</b>
            </p>
            <div className="lotus-tracker">
              <div className="tracker-title">
                <strong>Bảy đoá sen</strong>
                <span>{completed}/7</span>
              </div>
              <div className="lotus-row">
                {Array.from({ length: 7 }).map((_, i) => (
                  <Icon key={i} name="lotus" size={17} />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <p className="event-row">
              <Icon name="moon" size={14} /> {calendar[0]?.title ?? 'Mùng một sắp tới'}
            </p>
            <p className="event-row">
              <Icon name="bell" size={14} /> Công phu chung{' '}
              <b>{calendar.find((item) => item.eventType === 'practice')?.time ?? '18:00'}</b>
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </aside>

      <TouchJoystick onMove={moveScene} />

      <div className="hud-chips">
        <button type="button" className="hud-chip glass" onClick={toggleSeat}>
          <kbd>F</kbd> {seat !== null ? `Đứng dậy · #${seat}` : 'Chọn bồ đoàn'}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="hud-chip glass"
          onClick={() => {
            setPanel(null)
            setCommunityOpen(true)
          }}
        >
          <Icon name="message" size={14} /> Đạo tràng
        </button>
      </div>

      <nav className="action-dock glass" aria-label="Pháp môn tu tập">
        <div className="action-dock__scroll">
          {actions.map((action) => (
            <button
              type="button"
              className={activeAction === action.id ? 'selected' : ''}
              key={action.id}
              title={action.hint ? `${action.label} (${action.hint})` : action.label}
              onClick={() => chooseAction(action.id)}
            >
              <Icon name={action.icon} size={18} />
              <span>{action.label}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </nav>

      <aside className="mo-widget glass" aria-label="Mõ tụng kinh">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="mo-widget__fish"
          aria-label="Gõ mõ (phím Space)"
          onClick={knock}
        >
          <span key={knockPulse} className={knockPulse ? 'is-knocked' : ''}>
            <Icon name="fish" size={26} />
          </span>
          {knockPulse > 0 && (
            <em key={`plus-${knockPulse}`} aria-hidden="true">
              +1
            </em>
          )}
        </button>
        <div className="mo-widget__stats">
          <strong>
            Mõ <b>{knocks.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}</b>
          </strong>
          <small>Tràng hạt {beads}/108</small>
          <button
            type="button"
            className={autoKnock ? 'on' : ''}
            aria-pressed={autoKnock}
            onClick={() => setAutoKnock(!autoKnock)}
          >
            Tự gõ: {autoKnock ? 'Bật' : 'Tắt'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </aside>

      <button type="button" className="feedback-tab" onClick={() => setPanel('feedback')}>
        Góp ý, báo lỗi
      </button>

      {meditating && (
        <div className="chant-indicator">
          <span />
          <span />
          <span />
          <span /> Nam mô A Di Đà Phật
        </div>
      )}
      {phrase && (
        <div className="speech-bubble">
          <strong>{playerName}</strong>
          <span>{phrase}</span>
          <button type="button" aria-label="Đóng câu nói" onClick={() => setPhrase('')}>
            ×
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <CommunityOverlay
        playerName={playerName}
        open={communityOpen}
        onClose={() => setCommunityOpen(false)}
        onCall={() => {
          setCommunityOpen(false)
          setCallOpen(true)
        }}
      />
      <VideoCallOverlay
        playerName={playerName}
        open={callOpen}
        onClose={() => setCallOpen(false)}
        onMinimize={() => {
          setCallOpen(false)
          setCommunityOpen(true)
        }}
      />
      {panel && (
        <SystemPanel
          panel={panel}
          practices={practices}
          calendar={calendar}
          playerName={playerName}
          merit={merit}
          beads={beads}
          muted={muted}
          room={room}
          theme={theme}
          wishes={wishes}
          onClose={() => setPanel(null)}
          onNavigate={setPanel}
          onMerit={addMerit}
          onBeads={updateBeads}
          onName={setPlayerName}
          onMuted={setMuted}
          onRoom={setRoom}
          onTheme={(newTheme) => {
            setTheme(newTheme)
            const color = ROBE_COLORS[newTheme] || ROBE_COLORS.xanh
            if ((window as any).currentUserProfile) {
              ;(window as any).currentUserProfile.robeTheme = newTheme
              ;(window as any).currentUserProfile.robeColor = color
            }
            ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.broadcast?.('CHANGE_ROBE', {
              theme: newTheme,
              robeColor: color,
            })
            ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.trackCurrentUserPresence?.()
          }}
          onWish={(wish) => setWishes((current) => [...current, wish].slice(-20))}
          onPhrase={setPhrase}
          onKnock={knock}
          practice={practiceContext}
        />
      )}
      {toast && <div className="toast glass">{toast}</div>}
    </main>
  )
}

type CallProps = {

type GlyphName =
  | 'bell'
  | 'camera'
  | 'chat'
  | 'close'
  | 'copy'
  | 'invite'
  | 'lotus'
  | 'mic'
  | 'phone'
  | 'screen'
  | 'shield'
  | 'switch'
  | 'users'

function Glyph({ name, size = 18 }: { name: GlyphName; size?: number }) {
  const shapes: Record<GlyphName, ReactNode> = {
    bell: <path d="M18 8a6 6 0 0 0-12 0c0 7-3 7-3 9h18c0-2-3-2-3-9M10 21h4" />,
    camera: (
      <>
        <rect x="3" y="6" width="14" height="12" rx="3" />
        <path d="m17 10 4-2v8l-4-2" />
      </>
    ),
    chat: <path d="M21 12a8.5 8.5 0 0 1-9 8 10 10 0 0 1-4-.8L3 21l1.5-4A8 8 0 1 1 21 12Z" />,
    close: <path d="m7 7 10 10M17 7 7 17" />,
    copy: (
      <>

        <path d="M16 8V5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v9a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h3" />
      </>
    ),
    invite: <path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" />,
    lotus: (

        <path d="M12 21c-2.4-1.1-4-3-4-5.3 0-1.7 1-3.4 4-5.5 3 2.1 4 3.8 4 5.5 0 2.3-1.6 4.2-4 5.3Z" />

      </>
    ),
    mic: (
      <>
        <rect x="9" y="3" width="6" height="12" rx="3" />
        <path d="M5 11a7 7 0 0 0 14 0M12 18v3M8 21h8" />
      </>
    ),
    phone: (
      <path d="M7.5 4.5 10 9 8 11c1.2 2.4 2.6 3.8 5 5l2-2 4.5 2.5c.4 2-1 4-3.2 4C9.8 20.5 3.5 14.2 3.5 7.7c0-2.2 2-3.6 4-3.2Z" />
    ),
    screen: (
      <>
        <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="13" rx="2" />
        <path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4" />
      </>
    ),
    shield: <path d="M12 3 5 6v5c0 5 2.8 8.3 7 10 4.2-1.7 7-5 7-10V6l-7-3Z" />,
    switch: (

      </>
    ),
    users: (

        <circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3" />
        <path d="M3.5 20v-2a5.5 5.5 0 0 1 11 0v2M16 5.5a3 3 0 0 1 0 5.5M17 14c2 .8 3 2.2 3 4.5V20" />
      </>
    ),
  }

  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"

      aria-hidden="true"
      fill="none"

const quickPhrases = ['A Di Đà Phật', 'Tùy hỷ công đức', 'Thân tâm an lạc', 'Nguyện cầu bình an']
const presentPeople = [
  ['T', 'Thích Đào Đào', 'Đang thiền'],
  ['A', 'An Hiền', 'An tọa'],
  ['B', 'Thích Từ Bế', 'Đang niệm Phật'],
]

export default function CommunityOverlay({ playerName, open, onClose, onCall }: Props) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'common' | 'private' | 'people'>('common')
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('')
  const [micReady, setMicReady] = useState(false)
  const [onlineDevotees, setOnlineDevotees] = useState<any[]>([])

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateList = (e?: any) => {
      const list = e?.detail || ((window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.activeDevotees
        ? Array.from((window as any).SupabaseSanctuary.activeDevotees.values())
        : [])
      setOnlineDevotees(list)
    }
    window.addEventListener('sanctuary_devotees_updated', updateList)
    updateList()
    return () => window.removeEventListener('sanctuary_devotees_updated', updateList)
  }, [])
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([
    {
      id: 1,
      author: 'Chùa An Nhiên',
      body: 'Chào mừng bạn đến Đạo Tràng Chung. Gửi một lời lành để cùng nhau thực tập chánh niệm.',
      time: 'Bây giờ',
      system: true,
    },
  ])

  useEffect(() => {
    const onIncoming = (e: any) => {
      const msg = e.detail
      if (!msg) return
      const text = (msg.text || msg.body || '').trim()
      if (!text) return
      const myId = (window as any).SANCTUARY_CLIENT_ID || (window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.getClientId?.() || ''
      if (msg.senderId && msg.senderId === myId && !msg.isSelf) return
      const author = msg.author || msg.name || msg.fullName || msg.senderName || 'Đồng Tu'
      setMessages((current) => {
        if (msg.id && current.some((m) => m.id === msg.id)) return current
        return [
          ...current,
          {
            id: msg.id || Date.now(),
            author,
            body: text,
            time: 'Vừa xong',
            system: false,
          },
        ]
      })
    }
    const onRoomRealtime = (e: any) => {
      if (e.detail?.type === 'ROOM_CHAT') {
        onIncoming(e);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('community_chat_message', onIncoming);
    window.addEventListener('room-realtime-message', onRoomRealtime);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('community_chat_message', onIncoming);
      window.removeEventListener('room-realtime-message', onRoomRealtime);
    };
  }, [])
  const micRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null)

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      micRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
    },
    [],
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open || !micRef.current) return
    micRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
    micRef.current = null
    setMicReady(false)
  }, [open])

  if (!open) return null

  const send = (text = draft) => {
    const body = text.trim()
    if (!body) return
    const myId = (window as any).SANCTUARY_CLIENT_ID || (window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.getClientId?.() || ''
    const msg = {
      id: Date.now(),
      author: playerName,
      name: playerName,
      fullName: playerName,
      body,
      text: body,
      time: 'Vừa xong',
      system: false,
      senderId: myId,
      clientId: myId,
    }
    setMessages((current) => [...current, msg])
    setDraft('')

    // 1. Broadcast to all clients via Supabase Realtime
    ;(window as any).SupabaseSanctuary?.broadcast?.('ROOM_CHAT', msg)

    // 2. Dispatch locally for 3D speech bubble and room-chat history
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('community_chat_message', { detail: { ...msg, isSelf: true } }))
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('room-realtime-message', { detail: { type: 'ROOM_CHAT', ...msg } }))
  }

  const toggleMic = async () => {
    if (micReady) {
      micRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
      micRef.current = null
      setMicReady(false)
      return
    }
    try {
      micRef.current = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true })
      setMicReady(true)
    } catch {
      setMessages((current) => [
        ...current,
        {
          id: Date.now(),
          author: 'Hệ thống',
          body: 'Không thể mở micro. Hãy kiểm tra quyền micro trong trình duyệt.',
          time: 'Vừa xong',
          system: true,
        },
      ])
    }
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] grid place-items-center bg-[#080402]/60 p-3 backdrop-blur-md sm:p-6"
      role="presentation"
      onMouseDown={(event) => event.target === event.currentTarget && onClose()}
    >
      <section
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="community-title"
        className="relative flex h-[min(720px,calc(100svh-32px))] w-[min(980px,100%)] flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-[22px] border border-[#e2bd6e]/55 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_50%_0%,rgba(137,44,18,.32),transparent_45%),linear-gradient(160deg,#35150c,#1d0b06_62%,#140704)] text-[#f8eddb] shadow-[0_35px_100px_rgba(0,0,0,.7),0_0_0_5px_rgba(30,12,6,.9),0_0_0_6px_rgba(226,189,110,.2)]"
      >
        <header className="flex min-h-[66px] items-center gap-3 border-b border-[#e2bd6e]/25 px-4 sm:px-5">
          <span className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-[#e2bd6e]/50 bg-[#a75b16]/25 text-[#f5cf76] shadow-[0_0_18px_rgba(226,189,110,.2)]">
            <Glyph name="bell" size={19} />
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <h2 id="community-title" className="font-display text-lg font-bold text-[#ffe5aa]">
                Đạo Tràng Chung
              </h2>
              <span className="rounded-full border border-emerald-400/30 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300">
                {1 + onlineDevotees.length} Đồng Tu Trực Tuyến
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="truncate text-xs text-[#cbb28f]">Cùng niệm Phật · Cùng gieo lời lành</p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              if (typeof (window as any).startZaloVideoCall === 'function') {
                (window as any).startZaloVideoCall()
                onClose()
              } else {
                onCall()
              }
            }}
            className="hidden h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-300/50 bg-emerald-600/80 px-4 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-[0_5px_18px_rgba(5,150,105,.22)] transition hover:bg-emerald-500 sm:flex"
          >
            <Glyph name="camera" size={15} /> Gọi Video
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={toggleMic}
            aria-pressed={micReady}
            className={`hidden h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-4 text-xs font-bold transition sm:flex ${
              micReady
                ? 'border-emerald-300/40 bg-emerald-600/25 text-emerald-200'
                : 'border-[#e2bd6e]/35 bg-black/20 text-[#e7d2a9] hover:bg-[#e2bd6e]/10'
            }`}
          >
            <Glyph name="mic" size={15} /> {micReady ? 'Tắt mic' : 'Bật mic'}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Đóng Đạo Tràng Chung"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-[#e2bd6e]/35 bg-black/20 text-[#e7d2a9] transition hover:bg-[#e2bd6e] hover:text-[#2a1408]"
          >

        <nav

                          : 'border-[#f0b849]/55 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#a86218] to-[#6c310e] shadow-[0_8px_22px_rgba(91,42,10,.24)]'

                    thực.

                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-[#a99474]">Đang tu tập tại chùa · Bản thân</p>
                  </div>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-300">
                    <i className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" /> Bạn
                  </span>
                </article>

                {/* Remote live devotees */}
                {onlineDevotees.map((devotee: any) => {
                  const dName = devotee.name || devotee.fullName || 'Đồng Tu'
                  const dDharma = devotee.dharma || devotee.dharmaName || 'Tịnh Niệm'

                    >
                      <span className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-[#e2bd6e]/30 bg-[#5c2810] font-bold text-[#f4d17f]">

                    <span className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-[#e2bd6e]/20 bg-[#421c0b] text-xs font-bold text-[#d8b86d]">

          <aside className="hidden min-h-0 overflow-y-auto bg-black/10 p-4 md:block">

              Đạo hữu hiện diện
            </h3>

              Những nhân vật đang hiện diện trong cảnh Chánh Điện.
            </p>
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
              {onlineDevotees.map((d: any) => {
                const name = d.name || d.fullName || 'Đồng Tu'
                const seatStr = d.seatNo ? `Bồ đoàn #${d.seatNo}` : 'Sân Chùa'
                return (
                  <div key={d.clientId || d.id || name} className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <span className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full border border-[#f2c766]/30 bg-[#5c2810] text-xs font-bold text-[#f1c86d]">
                      {name.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}

                      <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-300">Trực tuyến · {seatStr}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )
              })}
              {presentPeople.slice(0, Math.max(1, 3 - onlineDevotees.length)).map(([initial, name, status]) => (
                <div key={name} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 opacity-70">
                  <span className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full bg-[#6f3013] text-xs font-bold text-[#f1c86d]">
                    {initial}
                  </span>
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <strong className="block truncate text-xs text-[#f5e4c5]">{name}</strong>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-[#cbb28f]">{status}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                if (typeof (window as any).startZaloVideoCall === 'function') {
                  (window as any).startZaloVideoCall()
                } else {
                  onCall()
                }
              }}
              className="mt-5 flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-300/45 bg-emerald-600/75 text-xs font-extrabold text-white transition hover:bg-emerald-500 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,.35)]"
            >
              <Glyph name="camera" size={15} /> Gọi Video Đạo Tràng
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={toggleMic}
              className="mt-2 flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-[#e2bd6e]/30 bg-[#e2bd6e]/[.06] text-xs font-bold text-[#e7d1a5]"
            >
              <Glyph name="mic" size={15} /> {micReady ? 'Tắt mic đàm thoại' : 'Bật mic đàm thoại'}
            </button>
            <div className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-[#e2bd6e]/18 bg-black/20 p-3">
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#dfc186]">Phiên thực hành cá nhân</p>
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-[#9c896e]">
                Tin nhắn chỉ được lưu trong phiên trình duyệt này, chưa đồng bộ đa thiết bị.
              </p>
            </div>
          </aside>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2 border-t border-[#e2bd6e]/18 p-3 sm:hidden">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              if (typeof (window as any).startZaloVideoCall === 'function') {
                (window as any).startZaloVideoCall()
                onClose()
              } else {
                onCall()
              }
            }}
            className="flex h-10 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 text-xs font-bold text-white"
          >
            <Glyph name="camera" size={15} /> Gọi Video
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={toggleMic}
            className="flex h-10 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-[#e2bd6e]/30 text-xs font-bold text-[#e6cfa3]"
          >
            <Glyph name="mic" size={15} /> {micReady ? 'Tắt mic' : 'Bật mic'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}

export function VideoCallOverlay({ playerName, open, onClose, onMinimize }: CallProps) {
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null)
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const [micOn, setMicOn] = useState(false)
  const [cameraOn, setCameraOn] = useState(false)
  const [shieldOn, setShieldOn] = useState(true)
  const [screenOn, setScreenOn] = useState(false)
  const [facing, setFacing] = useState<'user' | 'environment'>('user')
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0)
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('Đang chờ đạo hữu tham gia…')
  const [lotusKey, setLotusKey] = useState(0)

  const stopAll = useCallback(() => {
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
    streamRef.current = null
    if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = null
    setMicOn(false)
    setCameraOn(false)
    setScreenOn(false)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    setSeconds(0)
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setSeconds((value) => value + 1), 1000)
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer)
  }, [open])

  useEffect(() => stopAll, [stopAll])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) stopAll()
  }, [open, stopAll])

  const attach = (stream: MediaStream) => {
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
    streamRef.current = stream
    if (videoRef.current) {
      videoRef.current.srcObject = stream
      void videoRef.current.play().catch(() => undefined)
    }
  }

  const openCamera = async (nextFacing = facing) => {
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: nextFacing },
        audio: micOn,
      })
      attach(stream)
      setCameraOn(true)
      setScreenOn(false)
      setNotice('Camera của bạn đã sẵn sàng')
    } catch {
      setNotice('Không thể mở camera. Hãy kiểm tra quyền camera trong trình duyệt.')
    }
  }

  const toggleCamera = async () => {
    if (cameraOn || screenOn) {
      streamRef.current?.getVideoTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
      streamRef.current?.removeTrack(streamRef.current.getVideoTracks()[0])
      setCameraOn(false)
      setScreenOn(false)
      setNotice('Camera đang tắt · Đang chờ đạo hữu tham gia…')
      return
    }
    await openCamera()
  }

  const toggleMic = async () => {
    const audio = streamRef.current?.getAudioTracks()[0]
    if (audio) {
      audio.enabled = !micOn
      setMicOn(!micOn)
      return
    }
    try {
      const audioStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true })
      const track = audioStream.getAudioTracks()[0]
      if (streamRef.current) streamRef.current.addTrack(track)
      else attach(audioStream)
      setMicOn(true)
      setNotice('Micro đã bật')
    } catch {
      setNotice('Không thể mở micro. Hãy kiểm tra quyền micro trong trình duyệt.')
    }
  }

  const shareScreen = async () => {
    if (screenOn) {
      stopAll()
      setNotice('Đã dừng chia sẻ màn hình')
      return
    }
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ video: true, audio: false })
      attach(stream)
      setScreenOn(true)
      setCameraOn(false)
      setMicOn(false)
      setNotice('Đang chia sẻ màn hình')
      stream.getVideoTracks()[0].addEventListener('ended', () => {
        setScreenOn(false)
        setNotice('Đã dừng chia sẻ màn hình')
      })
    } catch {
      setNotice('Bạn chưa chọn màn hình để chia sẻ')
    }
  }

  const invite = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href)
      setNotice('Đã sao chép liên kết mời')
    } catch {
      setNotice('Mở trang này trên thiết bị của đạo hữu để cùng tham gia')
    }
  }

  if (!open) return null

  const time = `${String(Math.floor(seconds / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`

  const callButton = (
    label: string,
    icon: GlyphName,
    action: () => void,
    active = false,
    danger = false,
  ) => (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={action}
      className="group flex min-w-[62px] flex-col items-center gap-1.5"
    >
      <span
        className={`grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border shadow-lg transition group-hover:-translate-y-0.5 ${
          danger
            ? 'border-red-300/30 bg-red-600 text-white'
            : active
              ? 'border-emerald-300/50 bg-emerald-500 text-white'
              : 'border-white/15 bg-white/10 text-[#f4e4c8] backdrop-blur-md'
        }`}
      >
        <Glyph name={icon} size={18} />
      </span>
      <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-white/70">{label}</span>
    </button>
  )

  return (
    <section
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="call-title"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] overflow-hidden bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_50%_35%,#3f190c,#190905_60%,#080302)] text-white"
    >
      <header className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 z-10 flex items-start gap-3 p-3 sm:p-5">
        <span className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-[#e2bd6e]/50 bg-[#a95a16]/35 text-[#f5cf76] shadow-[0_0_22px_rgba(226,189,110,.24)]">
          <Glyph name="bell" size={18} />
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h2
            id="call-title"
            className="truncate text-sm font-extrabold text-[#fff0cc] sm:text-base"
          >
            Đạo Tràng Chung — Gọi Video Đạo Hữu
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 text-[10px] text-[#bca587]">
            <span>Trình duyệt trực tiếp</span>
            <span className="text-emerald-300">Local preview</span>
            <span>1 người</span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <span className="absolute left-1/2 top-14 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full border border-[#e2bd6e]/30 bg-black/30 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold tabular-nums text-[#f2ce76] sm:top-4">
          {time}
        </span>
        <div className="ml-auto flex gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              stopAll()
              onMinimize()
            }}
            className="hidden h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/15 bg-white/10 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-white/75 sm:flex"
          >
            Thu nhỏ
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Đóng cuộc gọi"
            onClick={() => {
              stopAll()
              onClose()
            }}
            className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full border border-white/15 bg-white/10 text-white/70"
          >
            <Glyph name="close" size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-[76px] z-10 hidden -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-300/25 bg-[#073b31]/65 px-4 py-1.5 text-[10px] text-emerald-100 backdrop-blur-md sm:flex">
        <Glyph name="shield" size={13} /> Chống hú đang bật · Dùng tai nghe khi hai máy ở gần nhau
      </div>

      <div className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center px-5 pb-28 pt-20">
        {(cameraOn || screenOn) && (
          <video
            ref={videoRef}
            muted
            playsInline
            aria-label={screenOn ? 'Màn hình đang chia sẻ' : 'Camera của bạn'}
            className={`h-full w-full object-cover ${cameraOn && facing === 'user' ? '-scale-x-100' : ''}`}
          />
        )}
        {!cameraOn && !screenOn && (
          <div className="text-center">
            <span className="relative mx-auto grid size-24 place-items-center rounded-full border border-[#e2bd6e]/30 bg-[#e2bd6e]/[.05] text-[#efc96d] shadow-[0_0_0_18px_rgba(226,189,110,.025)]">
              <Glyph name="lotus" size={34} />
              <i className="absolute inset-[-1px] animate-[spin_14s_linear_infinite] rounded-full border border-dashed border-emerald-400/35" />
            </span>
            <h3 className="mt-6 text-base font-extrabold text-[#fff0ce]">{notice}</h3>
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-emerald-300/80">
              Nhấn “Mời bạn” để sao chép liên kết trang
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
        {(cameraOn || screenOn) && (
          <div className="absolute bottom-32 right-4 w-28 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[#e2bd6e]/60 bg-black/60 p-2 shadow-xl sm:right-6 sm:top-16 sm:bottom-auto sm:h-36">
            <div className="grid h-full place-items-center rounded-xl bg-black/35 text-center">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#ffe2a1]">{playerName}</span>
              <small className="text-[10px] text-white/55">
                {screenOn ? 'Đang chia sẻ' : 'Bạn'}
              </small>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        {lotusKey > 0 && (
          <span
            key={lotusKey}
            className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-28 left-1/2 animate-[lantern-rise_3s_ease-out_forwards] text-pink-300"
          >
            <Glyph name="lotus" size={32} />
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <footer className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-10 flex justify-start overflow-x-auto bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/45 to-transparent px-3 pb-[max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] pt-9 [-ms-overflow-style:none] [scrollbar-width:none] sm:justify-center [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
        <div className="flex min-w-max gap-2 sm:gap-3">
          {callButton(micOn ? 'Tắt mic' : 'Mic', 'mic', () => void toggleMic(), micOn)}
          {callButton('Chống hú', 'shield', () => setShieldOn((value) => !value), shieldOn)}
          {callButton(
            cameraOn ? 'Tắt camera' : 'Camera',
            'camera',
            () => void toggleCamera(),
            cameraOn,
          )}
          {callButton(
            screenOn ? 'Dừng chia sẻ' : 'Chia sẻ',
            'screen',
            () => void shareScreen(),
            screenOn,
          )}
          {callButton('Đổi cam', 'switch', () => {
            const next = facing === 'user' ? 'environment' : 'user'
            setFacing(next)
            if (cameraOn) void openCamera(next)
          })}
          {callButton('Mời bạn', 'invite', () => void invite())}
          {callButton('Thả sen', 'lotus', () => {
            setLotusKey((value) => value + 1)
            setNotice('Một đóa sen đã được thả vào Đạo Tràng')
          })}
          {callButton(
            'Kết thúc',
            'phone',
            () => {
              stopAll()
              onClose()
            },
            false,
            true,
          )}
        </div>
      </footer>
    </section>
  )
}

import config from '@payload-config'
import { getPayload } from 'payload'
import ChuaSenApp from './ChuaSenApp'
import type { CalendarItem, PracticeItem } from './types'

export const dynamic = 'force-static'

export default async function HomePage() {
  const payload = await getPayload({ config })
  const [practiceResult, calendarResult] = await Promise.all([
    payload.find({
      collection: 'practice-content',
      limit: 50,
      pagination: false,
      sort: 'order',
      overrideAccess: false,
    }),
    payload.find({
      collection: 'calendar-events',
      limit: 30,
      pagination: false,
      sort: 'order',
      overrideAccess: false,
    }),
  ])

  return (
    <ChuaSenApp
      practices={practiceResult.docs as unknown as PracticeItem[]}
      calendar={calendarResult.docs as unknown as CalendarItem[]}
    />
  )
}

function dailyCount(key: string) {
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(key) ?? 'null') as {
      day: string
      count: number
    } | null
    return { today, count: saved?.day === today ? saved.count : 0 }
  } catch {
    return { today, count: 0 }
  }
}
function bumpDaily(key: string) {
  const { today, count } = dailyCount(key)
  window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ day: today, count: count + 1 }))
  return count + 1
}

  if (panel === 'certificate') return <CertificateView ctx={ctx} />
  if (panel === 'profile') return <ProfileView ctx={ctx} />
  if (panel === 'lantern') return <LanternView ctx={ctx} />
  return <ReleaseView ctx={ctx} />
}

function SeatsView({ ctx }: { ctx: PracticeContext }) {
  const [, setTick] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => {
    const onUpdate = () => setTick((t) => t + 1)
    window.addEventListener('sanctuary_devotees_updated', onUpdate)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('sanctuary_devotees_updated', onUpdate)
  }, [])
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[#f2c766]/25 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#8a3214]/55 to-[#8a3214]/5 px-4 py-3 text-center">
        <p className="font-serif text-sm font-bold text-[#ffe09a]">Tam Bảo · Chánh Điện</p>
        <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-white/60">Bàn thờ Phật · Lư hương · Đèn nến</p>
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr]">
        {(['left', 'right'] as const).map((side, index) => (
          <Fragment key={side}>
            {index === 1 && (
              <div className="hidden w-6 place-items-center rounded-full bg-[repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(226,189,110,.18)_0_6px,transparent_6px_12px)] sm:grid">
                <span className="sr-only">Lối đi giữa</span>
              </div>
            )}
            <section aria-label={side === 'left' ? 'Dãy bên trái' : 'Dãy bên phải'}>
              <p className="mb-1.5 text-center text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[#e2bd6e]/80">
                {side === 'left' ? 'Dãy tả' : 'Dãy hữu'}
              </p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
                {SEATS.filter((seat) => (side === 'left' ? seat.x < 0 : seat.x > 0)).map((seat) => {
                  const remoteDevotees = (window as any).sanctuarySeats || []
                  const remoteSeat = remoteDevotees.find((s: any) => s.seatNo === seat.no)
                  const remoteOccupant = (remoteSeat && remoteSeat.occupied && !remoteSeat.isUser && remoteSeat.remoteClientId)
                    ? (remoteSeat.name || 'Đồng Tu')
                    : null
                  const occupant = SEAT_OCCUPANTS[seat.no] || remoteOccupant
                  const mine = ctx.seat === seat.no
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={seat.no}
                      type="button"
                      disabled={Boolean(occupant) || mine}
                      aria-label={`Bồ đoàn số ${seat.no}, hàng ${seat.row + 1}${
                        mine
                          ? ', bạn đang ngồi'
                          : occupant
                            ? `, ${occupant} đang ngồi`
                            : ', còn trống'
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => {
                        ctx.onSeat(seat.no)
                        ctx.onClose()
                      }}
                      className={`flex min-h-[68px] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl border px-1 py-1.5 transition ${
                        mine
                          ? 'border-[#f2c766]/70 bg-[#f2c766]/15'
                          : occupant
                            ? 'cursor-default border-white/8 bg-white/[.03] opacity-70'
                            : 'border-[#e2bd6e]/25 bg-[#e2bd6e]/[.06] hover:border-[#f2c766]/50 hover:bg-[#e2bd6e]/15'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-white/55">#{seat.no}</span>
                      <span
                        className={`h-3.5 w-7 rounded-[50%] shadow-[inset_0_-3px_0_rgba(0,0,0,.25)] ${
                          occupant ? 'bg-[#6d3a2c]' : 'bg-[#a8453a]'
                        }`}
                      />
                      <span
                        className={`max-w-full truncate px-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                          mine ? gold : occupant ? 'text-white/75' : 'text-white/50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {mine ? 'Bạn' : occupant ? occupant.replace('Thích ', '') : 'Trống'}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            </section>
          </Fragment>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="text-center text-[13px] text-white/55">
        {SEATS.length - Object.keys(SEAT_OCCUPANTS).length - (ctx.seat ? 1 : 0)} bồ đoàn còn trống ·
        hàng trên cùng gần Tam Bảo nhất. Di chuyển (phím hoặc cần điều khiển) để đứng dậy.
      </p>
      {ctx.seat !== null && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`${ghostButton} justify-self-center`}
          onClick={() => {
            ctx.onStand()

        </button>
      )}

  )
}

const breathPhases = [
  { label: 'Hít vào', note: 'Tĩnh lặng', seconds: 4, scale: 1 },
  { label: 'Giữ hơi', note: 'An trú', seconds: 2, scale: 1 },
  { label: 'Thở ra', note: 'Mỉm cười', seconds: 6, scale: 0.55 },
]

function BreathView({ ctx }: { ctx: PracticeContext }) {
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false)
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState(2)
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState(0)
  const [cycles, setCycles] = useState(0)
  const onMerit = useRef(ctx.onMerit)
  onMerit.current = ctx.onMerit

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return
    const current = breathPhases[phase]
    setRemaining(current.seconds)
    const tick = window.setInterval(() => setRemaining((value) => Math.max(0, value - 1)), 1000)
    const next = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (phase === 2) {
        setCycles((count) => {
          const done = count + 1
          if (done % 3 === 0) onMerit.current(5, `Đã thở chánh niệm ${done} vòng · +5 công đức`)
          return done
        })
      }
      setPhase((value) => (value + 1) % breathPhases.length)
    }, current.seconds * 1000)
    return () => {
      window.clearInterval(tick)
      window.clearTimeout(next)
    }
  }, [running, phase])

  const current = breathPhases[phase]
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-center gap-5 py-2">
      <div className="relative grid size-60 place-items-center">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full border border-[#f2c766]/20" />
        <div
          className="absolute inset-3 rounded-full bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_40%_35%,rgba(255,226,160,.55),rgba(217,168,63,.18)_60%,transparent_72%)] shadow-[0_0_60px_rgba(242,199,102,.25)]"
          style={{
            transform: `scale(${running ? current.scale : 0.7})`,
            transition: `transform ${running ? current.seconds : 0.6}s ease-in-out`,
          }}
        />
        <div className="relative text-center">
          <p className="font-serif text-2xl font-bold text-[#ffe7b0]">
            {running ? current.label : 'Sẵn sàng'}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-white/65">
            {running ? `${current.note} · ${remaining}s` : 'Ngồi thẳng, thả lỏng vai'}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p className="text-center text-xs text-white/65">
        Hít vào 4 giây · Giữ 2 giây · Thở ra 6 giây. Mỗi 3 vòng nhận +5 công đức.
      </p>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          className={primaryButton}
          onClick={() => {
            if (!running) setPhase(0)
            setRunning(!running)
          }}
        >
          {running ? 'Tạm dừng' : 'Bắt đầu hơi thở'}
        </button>
        <span className="text-xs text-white/60">
          Đã thở <b className={gold}>{cycles}</b> vòng
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
